use_cases: filtering dust while maintaining acoustic attenuation in HVAC transfer ducts
inserting into electronic equipment enclosures and speaker grilles for dust and noise management
retrieval.rag_summary: Acoustica Dust Foam Filter is an open-cell reticulated polyurethane foam designed to capture airborne particulates and dust while permitting controlled airflow in acoustic and ventilation systems. Commonly fitted within acoustic transfer ducts, ventilation grilles, and electronic equipment housings, it provides mild sound damping alongside particulate filtration. It is lightweight, easily cut to fit irregular apertures, and washable or replaceable for ongoing maintenance.
